item.title: memories
item.description: had a profound remembrance today, doing what i had previously thought a mundane task and tried to think positively about during the last log. i suppose i regarded it as a trivial, time consuming thing with no potential of any intellectual benefit however, rendering out these item icons and many times re-rendering them, i remembered a very important factoid from college.
